'''Pinyumb''' was a [[capital]] [[city]] on the [[Volcano|volcanic]] [[planet]] of [[Sullust]] in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Scarif and others">{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}}</ref> It was located in a massive cavern under the south side of the volcanic mountain [[Inyusu Tor]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], Pinyumb was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire]]. When Sullust was targeted by the [[61st Mobile Infantry]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a [[Siege of Inyusu Tor|battle]] between the Alliance and the Empire was fought on the mountain above the city.<ref name="TC" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pinyumb appeared in the novel ''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'', which was written by [[Alexander Freed]] and published in [[2015]].<ref name="TC" />
